name: Gas reading
interpretation: IEEE-754 float32; units selected by register 5

name: Sensor mode
decode: 0 = normal; 1 = zero; 2 = calibration; 3 = alarm test; 5 = diagnostic; 6 = advanced; 7 = administrator

name: Supply voltage
interpretation: IEEE-754 float32; expected operating range 12 through 35 V

name: Fault code
decode: 0 = none; 1 = sensor-board communication loss; 4 = sensor-element communication loss; 5 = zero error; 6 = calibration error

name: Sensor type
decode: 0 = electrochemical; 1 = infrared; 2 = catalytic bead; 4 = photoionization detector

name: Relay settings
decode: bit 0 = relay 1 latch; bit 1 = relay 2 latch; bit 2 = relay 1 failsafe; bit 3 = relay 2 failsafe; bit 4 = relay 1 increasing; bit 5 = relay 2 increasing
